rules.design-workflow:
---
description: How to use the design skill packs in this project
---
# Design workflow

- Before UI work, read `DESIGN.md` at the project root if it exists (create it with the `create-design-md` skill); it is the single source of truth for tokens, type scale, spacing, motion and voice.
- Start from `baseline-ui` for any new screen, then `improve-ui` / `ui-designer` for craft, `fixing-accessibility` before shipping, `fixing-motion-performance` for anything animated.
- Use the `playwright` MCP server to look at what you built (screenshots, console errors) instead of guessing; use `chrome-devtools` for performance and accessibility audits.
- Never install design tooling globally: `npm install -D <pkg>` inside the project; Playwright browsers go to `.ai-sandbox/cache/ms-playwright` automatically.
- Keep component APIs small, prefer system tokens over magic numbers, and write the reasoning for a visual decision in the PR/commit message.

notes: Third-party skills keep their own licenses (MIT / Apache-2.0); see .ai-sandbox/bundles/bundles.lock.json.
Run `aisb sync` (done automatically) then start your tool; skills appear as /<name> in Claude Code and are auto-discovered by Cursor, Copilot, Gemini CLI and Antigravity.
